# E0209: name of a prelude item

The prelude's names, such as `print`, `Option` and `List`, mean the same thing in every module, so nothing else takes them. Choose another name.

- Rule: [`program.prelude-names`](../../reference/04-programs.md#program.prelude-names)
- Reported at: the declared name, or the `use` declaration that binds it.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `items` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0209:1
fn print(message: str) {}

fn main() {}
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
fn log(message: str) {}

fn main() {}
```

## What the compiler prints

`stilt check` on [`E0209_name_of_a_prelude_item.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0209_name_of_a_prelude_item.lt):

```text
── NAME OF A PRELUDE ITEM ───────── E0209_name_of_a_prelude_item.lt:1:4  [E0209]

`print` is the name of a prelude item:

  1 │ fn print(message: str) {}
    │    ^^^^^

The prelude's names, such as `print`, `Option` and `List`, mean the same thing
in every module, so nothing else takes them. Choose another name.
```
